messages:
Maria Chen: async check-in — packaging + quickstarts for samplekit
What I did: rebuilt mac wheels on CI runner, updated quickstart steps in docs, pushed branch samplekit/package-macos-fix
Blockers: sampleapp E2E failing only on mac-m1 job (node-gyp rebuild error), docs quickstart still references `npm install` which causes CI cache mismatch
Today: triage the mac-m1 flakes, open a focused docs PR to clarify Node/npm hints, add a fallback to use prebuilt wheels if rebuild fails
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/412

Samir Patel: saw the failure, digging into logs now — install step dies at native module compile: `gyp ERR! stack Error: .. node-gyp rebuild`
Seems we don't set proper env for homebrew flags on the runner. Quick test: setting `npm_config_arch=x64` made it pass locally for me once

Tony Nguyen: quick idea — for the CI job we should try a short-circuit to fetch prebuilt wheels from ops-artifacts when rebuild times out. I can add that in the workflow as a fallback

Alex Gomez: I can take docs PR for the quickstart. Will add explicit Node + NVM instructions and a note about `npm ci` vs `npm install` for reproducible builds

ci-bot: build sampleapp-e2e-mac-m1 #78 — failed (flaky). Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/78 (contains the node-gyp trace) :eyes:

Maria Chen: thanks — @Samir can you paste the minimal failing log snippet here? helps the ops fallback logic

Samir Patel: snippet pasted below:
```
npm ERR! code 1
npm ERR! path /home/runner/work/sampleapp/node_modules/some-native
gyp ERR! stack Error: `make` failed with exit code: 2
```
Seems related to missing Xcode CLT equivalent on the mac runner image

Tony Nguyen: workflow fallback patch (WIP):
```
- name: try prebuilt wheel
  run: |
    if curl -fSO "$ARTIFACTS_URL/$PKG-$VERSION-$ARCH.whl"; then
      pip install $PKG-$VERSION-$ARCH.whl
    else
      ./scripts/build-wheel.sh
    fi
```
I'll open the PR in a bit

Alex Gomez: on docs — adding a short troubleshooting section for mac/apple silicon: brew install python@3.10, xcode-select --install, use `arch -x86_64` for legacy modules, and link to the packaging PR

Maria Chen: perfect. Also include a one-liner to force x64 build in CI if needed: `env npm_config_arch=x64 npm ci` — saves time until we get universal wheels

Samir Patel: FYI I pushed a quick commit to the workflow to set that env var as a band-aid (samplekit#413)

Tony Nguyen: I'll run the mac runner locally tonight and try to reproduce. If anyone wants access to my testing snapshot, lmk

Alex Gomez: will draft the doc PR now and ping for review — should be quick

Maria Chen: OK wrapping up my async — assigning ownership: @Tony infra fallback + repro, @Samir CI band-aid + logs, @Alex docs PR. I'll follow up on the samplekit PR and land the packaging script change if CI is green. :shipit:

ci-bot: note — there are related flaky jobs: sampleapp-e2e-linux #102, sampleapp-e2e-mac-m1 #78, samplekit-package-macos #21

Samir Patel: thanks, will monitor the flakes and revert band-aid if we land universal wheels

Maria Chen: thanks team, ping here if you hit anything blocking.
